runtime_connector_id.description: Optional connector id sent as x-connector-id when Edge runtime endpoints require connector-bound runtime authentication.

runtime_secret.description: Optional runtime secret sent as x-connector-secret to protected Edge device endpoints. Phase 1 lab bridge; production should replace this with device-bound credentials.

runtime_secret_file.description: Optional local file path containing the runtime secret. This lets MDM-managed config reference a device-local credential without embedding the secret value.

runtime_secret_keychain_service.description: Optional macOS Keychain generic-password service name used to resolve the runtime secret when runtime_secret and runtime_secret_file are not set.

runtime_secret_keychain_account.description: Optional macOS Keychain generic-password account used with runtime_secret_keychain_service.

fetch_trusted_keyring.description: When true, the agent fetches /devices/{device_id}/trusted-keyring from Edge after registration and uses it to verify the fetched policy bundle.

network_extension_rules_ref.description: Optional path to generated network_extension_steering_rules.v1 manifest used by App Proxy Provider / Packet Tunnel Provider steering.

network_extension_runtime_evidence_ref.description: Optional path to Network Extension runtime evidence JSON collected by the provider or Phase 1 not-installed contract. The Local Client reports it in Agent Status without treating would-steer evidence as installed runtime proof.

network_extension_runtime_copy_endpoint_.description: Optional Edge endpoint path used by the Network Extension runtime-copy transport. When omitted, the provider uses the reviewed default round-trip endpoint path.

network_extension_runtime_copy_transport.description: Optional non-secret runtime-copy transport evidence label scope. real_edge is the production Edge/Connector path; lab_endpoint is only for the Phase 2 human smoke harness responder and must not be used to claim real Edge/Connector product traversal.

network_extension_runtime_copy_evidence_.description: Optional path to the non-secret Network Extension runtime-copy evidence JSON written by the provider during Phase 2 flow-copy smoke. The file contains counts and gate categories only.

windows_observe_mode_report_ref.description: Optional path to Windows Observe Mode report JSON. Before WFP/WinDivert is installed, the Local Client reports this as driver/filter not installed and enforcement disabled.

local_proxy_metrics_url.description: Optional local proxy /metrics URL. When present, the Local Client reports observed proxy steering counters in agent status telemetry.
